```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(data.table)
library(knitr)

has_pdftools  <- requireNamespace("pdftools",  quietly = TRUE)

dge_dir      <- params$dge_dir
organism     <- params$organism
project_name <- params$project_name

# ─── Helper functions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

safe_read <- function(path, ...) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  tryCatch(data.table::fread(path, fill = TRUE, ...), error = function(e) NULL)
}

filter_sig <- function(df, threshold = 0.05) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
  pcol <- intersect(c("p.adjust","Adjusted.P.value","pvalue","FDR","fdr"), names(df))
  if (length(pcol) == 0) return(df)
  pcol <- pcol[1]
  df[[pcol]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[pcol]]))
  sig <- df[!is.na(df[[pcol]]) & df[[pcol]] < threshold, ]
  if (nrow(sig) == 0) return(NULL)
  sig
}

# Parse a "k/n" ratio string (e.g. "5/203") to a numeric fraction. Vectorised.
parse_ratio <- function(x) {
  vapply(strsplit(as.character(x), "/", fixed = TRUE), function(p) {
    p <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(p))
    if (length(p) == 2 && !any(is.na(p)) && p[2] != 0) p[1] / p[2] else NA_real_
  }, numeric(1))
}

# Ensure a FoldEnrichment column exists. clusterProfiler tables already carry one;
# for tables that only have GeneRatio + BgRatio (e.g. enrichr), compute it as
# FoldEnrichment = (GeneRatio) / (BgRatio) = (k/n) / (M/N).
add_fold_enrichment <- function(df) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(df)
  fe_existing <- intersect(c("FoldEnrichment","fold_enrichment","Fold.Enrichment","foldEnrichment"),
                           names(df))
  if (length(fe_existing) > 0) return(df)
  if (all(c("GeneRatio","BgRatio") %in% names(df))) {
    fe <- parse_ratio(df[["GeneRatio"]]) / parse_ratio(df[["BgRatio"]])
    df[["FoldEnrichment"]] <- round(fe, 3)
  }
  df
}

# Count DEGs for a comparison directly from the DGE_analysis_<comp>.txt table in
# the DGE directory (always present, unlike the transient *_Gene_IDs.txt lists,
# which live inside the funct_enrichment tarball and are absent at render time).
# clusterProfiler builds its input gene sets at FDR < 0.05 and FDR < 0.01 (see
# R_clusterProfiler_analyses_parallel.R), so the recap reports both. A gene is a
# DEG when FDR < threshold; up/down split on the sign of its logFC. Returns a
# list keyed by threshold string, each a list(total, up, down); entries are NA
# if the table can't be read.
deg_counts <- function(comp, thresholds = c(0.05, 0.01)) {
  na1   <- list(total = NA_integer_, up = NA_integer_, down = NA_integer_)
  empty <- setNames(rep(list(na1), length(thresholds)), as.character(thresholds))
  df    <- safe_read(file.path(dge_dir, paste0(comp, ".txt")))
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(empty)
  fdr_col <- intersect(c("FDR","fdr","p.adjust","padj","adj.P.Val"), names(df))
  if (length(fdr_col) == 0) return(empty)
  fdr     <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[fdr_col[1]]]))
  lfc_col <- names(df)[grepl("^logFC", names(df))]
  lfc     <- if (length(lfc_col) > 0) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[lfc_col[1]]])) else NULL
  out <- lapply(thresholds, function(th) {
    sig <- !is.na(fdr) & fdr < th
    up <- down <- NA_integer_
    if (!is.null(lfc)) {
      up   <- sum(sig & !is.na(lfc) & lfc > 0)
      down <- sum(sig & !is.na(lfc) & lfc < 0)
    }
    list(total = sum(sig), up = up, down = down)
  })
  setNames(out, as.character(thresholds))
}

select_cols <- function(df) {
  prio <- c("ONTOLOGY","Description","term.label","Term",
            "ID","GeneRatio","BgRatio","FoldEnrichment","RichFactor","zScore",
            "Count","number_in_list",
            "pvalue","p.adjust","FDR","fdr","Adjusted.P.value",
            "fold_enrichment","plus_minus",
            "Gene_ID_up_num","Gene_ID_down_num","Gene_ID_num",
            "geneID","Gene_ID","summary_up","summary_down")
  avail <- intersect(prio, names(df))
  if (length(avail) < 2) avail <- names(df)[seq_len(min(10, ncol(df)))]
  df[, avail, with = FALSE]
}

make_table <- function(df, filename = NULL, max_rows = NULL) {
  # max_rows is accepted for back-compat with older callers but ignored: the DT
  # table paginates the full result set, so nothing is truncated.
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
    cat("<p><em>No results found</em></p>\n\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  df <- add_fold_enrichment(df)
  display <- as.data.frame(select_cols(df))
  # Round enrichment/score columns for on-screen readability (CSV keeps full precision)
  for (nm in intersect(c("FoldEnrichment","RichFactor","zScore"), names(display)))
    display[[nm]] <- round(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(display[[nm]])), 2)

  # Full interactive table: all rows (paginated), per-column search boxes,
  # click-to-sort headers, page-length dropdown (10 default / 20 / 50 / 100 / All).
  # NO scrollX: DataTables' internal horizontal scroll miscomputes / throws when a
  # table initialises inside a hidden (display:none) Bootstrap tab, and a throw
  # there aborts HTMLWidgets.staticRender() for every widget after it — which is
  # why only the first tab used to show a table. Wide tables scroll via CSS on the
  # wrapper instead (.dataTables_wrapper{overflow-x:auto}); deferRender keeps init
  # cheap when there are many tables on the page.
  widget <- DT::datatable(
    display,
    rownames  = FALSE,
    filter    = "top",
    escape    = TRUE,
    width     = "100%",
    class     = "compact stripe hover row-border order-column",
    options   = list(
      pageLength  = 10,
      lengthMenu  = list(c(10, 20, 50, 100, -1),
                         c("10", "20", "50", "100", "All")),
      autoWidth   = FALSE,
      deferRender = TRUE,
      dom         = "lfrtip"
    )
  )
  cat(knitr::knit_print(widget), "\n\n")

  if (!is.null(filename)) {
    csv_text <- paste(capture.output(write.csv(df, stdout(), row.names = FALSE)), collapse = "\n")
    b64 <- xfun::base64_encode(charToRaw(csv_text))
    cat(sprintf('<p><a href="data:text/csv;base64,%s" download="%s" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary">\u2b07 Download CSV (%d rows)</a></p>\n\n',
                b64, filename, nrow(df)))
  }
}

# Render an optional AI insight (a *.ai_insight.md written by scripts/llm_insight.py)
# as a styled callout above the results. No-op when the file is absent, so this is
# invisible unless AI insights were enabled (-llm_endpoint + ai_insights). The first
# line is the "AI summary - model/date" stamp; remaining lines are the body. Minimal
# markdown (**bold**, `code`) is converted; everything else is HTML-escaped.
render_ai_insight <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(invisible())
  txt <- tryCatch(readLines(path, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8"), error = function(e) character(0))
  txt <- txt[nzchar(trimws(txt))]
  if (!length(txt)) return(invisible())
  esc <- function(s) {
    s <- gsub("&", "&amp;", s, fixed = TRUE)
    s <- gsub("<", "&lt;", s, fixed = TRUE); s <- gsub(">", "&gt;", s, fixed = TRUE)
    s <- gsub("\\*\\*(.+?)\\*\\*", "<strong>\\1</strong>", s)
    gsub("`(.+?)`", "<code>\\1</code>", s)
  }
  stamp <- esc(txt[1])
  body  <- if (length(txt) > 1) paste(sprintf('<p style="margin:4px 0;">%s</p>',
                                               vapply(txt[-1], esc, character(1))), collapse = "\n") else ""
  cat(sprintf('
<div style="background:#eef6ff;border-left:5px solid #4a90d9;padding:10px 14px;margin:12px 0;border-radius:4px;font-size:13px;">
<div style="color:#5a6b7b;font-size:11px;margin-bottom:6px;">\U0001f916 %s</div>
%s
</div>\n\n', stamp, body))
}

# Render the PER-TABLE AI notes (the MAP step summaries llm_insight.py wrote to
# <comp>.enrichment_ai_pertable.tsv: one short summary per enrichment table that
# was sent). Shown as a collapsible list under the per-comparison narrative, so the
# individual per-table interpretations are available in addition to the synthesis.
# No-op when the sidecar is absent (AI off, or a timeout skipped the option).
render_pertable_ai <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(invisible())
  df <- tryCatch(utils::read.delim(path, sep = "\t", quote = "", comment.char = "",
                                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE),
                 error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(df) || !nrow(df) || !all(c("table", "summary") %in% names(df))) return(invisible())
  esc <- function(s) {
    s <- gsub("&", "&amp;", s, fixed = TRUE)
    s <- gsub("<", "&lt;", s, fixed = TRUE); gsub(">", "&gt;", s, fixed = TRUE)
  }
  rows <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) {
    meta <- ""
    if (all(c("tps", "seconds") %in% names(df)))
      meta <- sprintf(" <span style=\"color:#8595a3;\">(%s TPS, %ss)</span>",
                      esc(df$tps[i]), esc(df$seconds[i]))
    sprintf('<li style="margin:4px 0;"><code>%s</code>%s<br>%s</li>',
            esc(df$table[i]), meta, esc(df$summary[i]))
  }, character(1))
  cat(sprintf('
<details style="margin:8px 0 14px;">
<summary style="cursor:pointer;color:#4a90d9;font-size:13px;">\U0001f916 Per-table AI notes (%d tables) — individual summaries behind the narrative above</summary>
<ul style="font-size:13px;margin:8px 0 0;padding-left:20px;">
%s
</ul>
</details>\n\n', nrow(df), paste(rows, collapse = "\n")))
}

# clusterProfiler runs ORA separately on the DEGs called at FDR < 0.05 and at
# FDR < 0.01, writing distinct ..._fdr_fdr_05.txt / ..._fdr_fdr_01.txt files (and
# matching *_fdr_05_*/*_fdr_01_* figures). The report used to read only files[1],
# which \u2014 because list.files() sorts alphabetically \u2014 always showed the fdr_01
# set while labelling it "p < 0.05". These helpers render one block per input
# threshold instead, so the two are never conflated.
threshold_token <- function(path) {
  m <- regmatches(basename(path), regexpr("fdr_0[15](_log(pos|neg))?", basename(path)))
  if (length(m) == 0) NA_character_ else m
}
threshold_label <- function(tok) {
  thr <- if (grepl("^fdr_05", tok)) "FDR < 0.05"
         else if (grepl("^fdr_01", tok)) "FDR < 0.01"
         else return(tok)
  if (grepl("_logpos$", tok))      sprintf("Up-regulated DEGs (%s)", thr)
  else if (grepl("_logneg$", tok)) sprintf("Down-regulated DEGs (%s)", thr)
  else                             sprintf("All DEGs (%s)", thr)
}

# Render the clusterProfiler ORA + GSEA sections for ONE DEG-input threshold
# ("fdr_05" or "fdr_01"). Headings start at level 3 (### ORA) so they nest under a
# level-2 threshold tab. `primary` (the FDR<0.05 tab) is where shared, non
# threshold-specific pathway images (KEGG / Reactome snapshots) are embedded, so
# they are not duplicated across both threshold tabs.
render_cp_threshold <- function(cp_dir, comp, tok, full_mode_ran, primary) {
  full_mode_note <- function(what) {
    if (full_mode_ran) { cat("*Not available*\n\n"); return(invisible()) }
    cat(sprintf(paste0('<div class="alert alert-secondary" ',
      'style="border-left:4px solid #999;padding:10px;margin:8px 0;">',
      '<em>Not run.</em> %s runs only in full clusterProfiler mode. Set ',
      '<code>clusterProfiler_full: yes</code> to enable GSEA, KEGG modules, ',
      'WikiPathways and Disease Ontology.</div>\n\n'), what))
  }
  # Pick the single result file for this threshold and render count + full table.
  section <- function(files, noun, csv_stub, figs_fn = NULL) {
    files <- files[!grepl("_err\\.txt$|_aPEAR|_clusters|_similarity", files)]
    toks  <- vapply(files, threshold_token, character(1))
    f <- if (any(toks == tok, na.rm = TRUE)) files[which(toks == tok)][1] else NA_character_
    if (is.na(f)) { cat("*No results file for this threshold.*\n\n"); return(invisible()) }
    df <- safe_read(f)
    n_total <- if (is.null(df)) 0 else nrow(df)
    sig <- filter_sig(df); n_sig <- if (!is.null(sig)) nrow(sig) else 0
    cat(sprintf("**%d** %s (**%d** significant, adjusted p < 0.05)\n\n", n_total, noun, n_sig))
    make_table(df, paste0(csv_stub, "_", tok, ".csv"))
    if (!is.null(figs_fn)) figs_fn()
  }

  cat("\n### ORA (clusterProfiler) {.tabset}\n\n")

  # -- Gene Ontology --
  cat("\n#### Gene Ontology {.tabset}\n\n")
  go_figs <- file.path(cp_dir, "go_figs")
  for (ont in c("BP", "MF", "CC")) {
    ont_label <- c(BP = "Biological Process", MF = "Molecular Function",
                   CC = "Cellular Component")[[ont]]
    cat(sprintf("\n##### GO %s\n\n", ont_label))
    tbl <- list.files(cp_dir,
             pattern = sprintf("GO_overrepresentation_test_%s_.*\\.txt$", ont),
             full.names = TRUE)
    section(tbl, sprintf("GO %s terms", ont), sprintf("%s_GO_%s_ORA", comp, ont),
      figs_fn = function() {
        if (!dir.exists(go_figs)) return(invisible())
        d <- list.files(go_figs,
               pattern = sprintf("overrepresentation_test_%s_.*%s_dotplot\\.pdf$", ont, tok),
               full.names = TRUE)
        if (length(d)) embed_pdf(d[1], sprintf("GO %s - Dotplot", ont))
        b <- list.files(go_figs,
               pattern = sprintf("overrepresentation_test_%s_.*%s_barplot\\.pdf$", ont, tok),
               full.names = TRUE)
        if (length(b)) embed_pdf(b[1], sprintf("GO %s - Barplot", ont))
      })
  }
  cat("\n##### GO ALL (combined)\n\n")
  go_all <- list.files(cp_dir, pattern = "^GO_overrepresentation_test_.*\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)
  go_all <- go_all[!grepl("_BP_|_MF_|_CC_", basename(go_all))]
  section(go_all, "GO terms (combined)", sprintf("%s_GO_ALL_ORA", comp))

  # -- KEGG --
  cat("\n#### KEGG {.tabset}\n\n")
  cat("\n##### KEGG Enrichment\n\n")
  section(list.files(cp_dir, pattern = "^KEGG_enrich_.*\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE),
          "KEGG pathways", sprintf("%s_KEGG_ORA", comp),
    figs_fn = if (!primary) NULL else function() {
      snap <- file.path(cp_dir, "kegg_paths_snapshots")
      if (dir.exists(snap)) {
        for (p in head(list.files(snap, pattern = "\\.png$", full.names = TRUE), 5)) embed_png(p, basename(p))
        for (p in head(list.files(snap, pattern = "KEGG.*barplot", full.names = TRUE), 1)) embed_pdf(p, "KEGG - Barplot")
        for (p in head(list.files(snap, pattern = "KEGG.*dotplot", full.names = TRUE), 1)) embed_pdf(p, "KEGG - Dotplot")
      }
    })
  cat("\n##### KEGG Modules\n\n")
  mk <- list.files(cp_dir, pattern = "^MKEGG_.*\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)
  mk <- mk[!grepl("GSEA", mk)]
  if (length(mk)) section(mk, "KEGG modules", sprintf("%s_MKEGG_ORA", comp))
  else full_mode_note("KEGG module over-representation")

  # -- Reactome --
  cat("\n#### Reactome\n\n")
  section(list.files(cp_dir, pattern = "^REACT_[^G].*\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE),
          "Reactome pathways", sprintf("%s_Reactome_ORA", comp),
    figs_fn = if (!primary) NULL else function() {
      snap <- file.path(cp_dir, "reactome_paths_snapshots")
      if (dir.exists(snap))
        for (p in head(list.files(snap, pattern = "\\.pdf$", full.names = TRUE), 3))
          if (!grepl("_err", p)) embed_pdf(p, basename(p))
    })

  # -- WikiPathways --
  cat("\n#### WikiPathways\n\n")
  wp <- list.files(cp_dir, pattern = "^WP_[^G].*\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)
  wp <- wp[!grepl("GSEA", wp)]
  if (length(wp)) section(wp, "WikiPathways", sprintf("%s_WikiPathways_ORA", comp))
  else full_mode_note("WikiPathways over-representation")

  # -- Disease Ontology --
  do_files <- list.files(cp_dir, pattern = "^DO_|^NCG_|^NGC_|^DGN_", full.names = TRUE)
  do_files <- do_files[!grepl("_err\\.txt$|GSEA|_aPEAR", do_files)]
  if (length(do_files)) {
    cat("\n#### Disease Ontology {.tabset}\n\n")
    dsel <- do_files[which(vapply(do_files, threshold_token, character(1)) == tok)]
    if (!length(dsel)) cat("*No results for this threshold.*\n\n")
    for (f in dsel) {
      bname <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f))
      cat(sprintf("\n##### %s\n\n", bname))
      df <- safe_read(f); n_total <- if (is.null(df)) 0 else nrow(df)
      sig <- filter_sig(df); n_sig <- if (!is.null(sig)) nrow(sig) else 0
      cat(sprintf("**%d** terms (**%d** significant, adjusted p < 0.05)\n\n", n_total, n_sig))
      make_table(df, paste0(bname, ".csv"))
    }
  } else {
    cat("\n#### Disease Ontology\n\n")
    full_mode_note("Disease Ontology (DO / NCG / DGN) over-representation")
  }

  # -- GSEA --
  gsea <- list.files(cp_dir, pattern = "GSEA_.*\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)
  gsea <- gsea[!grepl("_err\\.txt$|_aPEAR|_clusters|_similarity", gsea)]
  gsea <- gsea[which(vapply(gsea, threshold_token, character(1)) == tok)]
  if (!length(gsea)) {
    cat("\n### GSEA\n\n"); full_mode_note("Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA)")
  } else {
    cat("\n### GSEA {.tabset}\n\n")
    gsea_one <- function(f) {
      df <- safe_read(f); n_total <- if (is.null(df)) 0 else nrow(df)
      sig <- filter_sig(df); n_sig <- if (!is.null(sig)) nrow(sig) else 0
      cat(sprintf("**%s** (%d rows, %d significant)\n\n", basename(f), n_total, n_sig))
      make_table(df, gsub("\\.txt$", ".csv", basename(f)))
    }
    go_gsea <- gsea[grepl("^GO_GSEA_", basename(gsea))]
    if (length(go_gsea)) {
      cat("\n#### GO GSEA {.tabset}\n\n")
      for (g in list(list(f = go_gsea[grepl("_BP\\.", basename(go_gsea))],  l = "GO BP GSEA"),
                     list(f = go_gsea[grepl("_MF\\.", basename(go_gsea))],  l = "GO MF GSEA"),
                     list(f = go_gsea[grepl("_CC\\.", basename(go_gsea))],  l = "GO CC GSEA"),
                     list(f = go_gsea[!grepl("_BP\\.|_MF\\.|_CC\\.", basename(go_gsea))], l = "GO ALL GSEA"))) {
        if (length(g$f)) { cat(sprintf("\n##### %s\n\n", g$l)); for (f in head(g$f, 2)) gsea_one(f) }
      }
    }
    blk <- function(sel, title, n = 2) {
      if (length(sel)) { cat(sprintf("\n#### %s\n\n", title)); for (f in head(sel, n)) gsea_one(f) }
    }
    blk(gsea[grepl("^KEGG_GSEA_|^KEGG_DOSE_", basename(gsea))], "KEGG GSEA")
    blk(gsea[grepl("^MKEGG_GSEA_", basename(gsea))], "KEGG Module GSEA")
    blk(gsea[grepl("^WP_GSEA_", basename(gsea))], "WikiPathways GSEA")
    blk(gsea[grepl("^REACT_GSEA_", basename(gsea))], "Reactome GSEA")
    blk(gsea[grepl("^DO_GSEA_|^NCG_GSEA_|^DGN_GSEA_", basename(gsea))], "Disease Ontology GSEA", 4)
  }
  invisible()
}

embed_png <- function(path, caption = "", max_width = "700px") {
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(invisible(NULL))
  uri <- xfun::base64_uri(path)
  fname <- basename(path)
  # Base64-encode the original file for download
  dl_b64 <- xfun::base64_encode(readBin(path, "raw", file.info(path)$size))
  dl_mime <- if (grepl("\\.png$", fname, ignore.case = TRUE)) "image/png" else "image/jpeg"
  cat(sprintf('<figure style="margin:10px 0;text-align:center;"><img src="%s" style="max-width:%s;border:1px solid #ddd;border-radius:4px;padding:2px;" />',
              uri, max_width))
  if (nchar(caption) > 0)
    cat(sprintf('<figcaption style="font-style:italic;color:#666;font-size:0.9em;">%s</figcaption>', caption))
  cat(sprintf('<br/><a href="data:%s;base64,%s" download="%s" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" style="margin-top:4px;">\u2b07 Download %s</a>',
              dl_mime, dl_b64, fname, fname))
  cat('</figure>\n\n')
}

embed_pdf <- function(pdf_path, caption = "", dpi = 48) {
  if (!has_pdftools || !file.exists(pdf_path)) return(invisible(NULL))
  tryCatch({
    tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
    pdftools::pdf_convert(pdf_path, format = "png", pages = 1, dpi = dpi,
                          filenames = tmp, verbose = FALSE)
    fname <- basename(pdf_path)
    # Show rendered PNG preview
    uri <- xfun::base64_uri(tmp)
    # Base64-encode the original PDF for download
    dl_b64 <- xfun::base64_encode(readBin(pdf_path, "raw", file.info(pdf_path)$size))
    cat(sprintf('<figure style="margin:10px 0;text-align:center;"><img src="%s" style="max-width:700px;border:1px solid #ddd;border-radius:4px;padding:2px;" />', uri))
    if (nchar(caption) > 0)
      cat(sprintf('<figcaption style="font-style:italic;color:#666;font-size:0.9em;">%s</figcaption>', caption))
    cat(sprintf('<br/><a href="data:application/pdf;base64,%s" download="%s" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" style="margin-top:4px;">\u2b07 Download PDF</a>',
                dl_b64, fname))
    cat('</figure>\n\n')
    unlink(tmp)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
}

show_file_set <- function(dir_path, table_pattern, label,
                          plot_dir = NULL, plot_pattern = NULL, dpi = 48) {
  files <- sort(list.files(dir_path, pattern = table_pattern, full.names = TRUE))
  files <- files[!grepl("_err\\.txt$|_aPEAR|_clusters|_similarity|revigo", files)]
  if (length(files) == 0) {
    cat(sprintf("*%s — not available*\n\n", label))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  for (f in files) {
    df  <- safe_read(f)
    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) next
    sig <- filter_sig(df)
    n_sig <- if (!is.null(sig)) nrow(sig) else 0
    cat(sprintf("\n**%s** — %d significant of %d tested\n\n", basename(f), n_sig, nrow(df)))
    make_table(df, gsub("\\.txt$", ".csv", basename(f)))
  }
  if (!is.null(plot_pattern) && !is.null(plot_dir) && dir.exists(plot_dir)) {
    plots <- sort(list.files(plot_dir, pattern = plot_pattern, full.names = TRUE))
    for (p in head(plots, 3)) {
      ext <- tolower(tools::file_ext(p))
      if (ext == "pdf") embed_pdf(p, basename(p), dpi = dpi)
      else if (ext %in% c("png","jpg","jpeg")) embed_png(p, basename(p))
    }
  }
}
```

```{r dt-init, echo=FALSE}
# Prime the DataTables/jQuery/htmlwidgets assets once. Every table below is
# emitted inside a results='asis' loop via cat(knit_print(widget)), which drops
# the per-widget dependency metadata; rendering one real (hidden) datatable here
# forces those assets into the self-contained HTML so the cat()-ed widgets can
# initialise on load. It lives in a display:none div, so nothing is visible.
htmltools::tagList(
  htmltools::tags$div(
    style = "display:none;",
    DT::datatable(data.frame(` ` = character(0), check.names = FALSE),
                  options = list(dom = "t"))
  )
)
```

```{r custom-css, results='asis'}
cat('<style>
.table { margin-bottom: 5px; }
figure img { box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); }
.btn-outline-primary { margin: 5px 0; }

/* Compact DataTables that sit inside the enrichment tabs */
.dataTables_wrapper { margin: 8px 0 18px; font-size: 12px; overflow-x: auto; }
table.dataTable { font-size: 12px; }
table.dataTable thead th { white-space: nowrap; }
.dataTables_wrapper .dataTables_filter input,
.dataTables_wrapper .dataTables_length select { margin: 0 4px; }
</style>\n')

# Why only the first table used to render: HTMLWidgets.staticRender() loops over
# every widget with NO per-widget try/catch, so the instant one DataTable throws
# during init, every later table is silently skipped. Verified on this report:
# staticRender aborted after ~4 of 73 widgets (only 4 got .html-widget-static-bound
# and 1 <table> was built). It is NOT a visibility problem - the previous
# force-visible attempt made the panes visible yet staticRender still aborted.
# Fix, resilient and independent of the buildTabsets/staticRender ordering:
#  (1) harden(): wrap each binding renderValue in try/catch so one failure is
#      contained and the loop finishes -> the remaining tables render.
#  (2) lazy + on-show: defer widgets that are hidden at load (only the visible tab
#      renders up front, keeping load light on a 70+ table report) and render any
#      still-unrendered widget the moment its tab/pill is shown, then fix widths.
cat('<script>
(function () {
  function isHidden(el){ return el.offsetParent === null; }
  function hasTable(el){ return !!el.querySelector("table.dataTable"); }
  function harden(){
    (window.HTMLWidgets && HTMLWidgets.widgets || []).forEach(function (b) {
      if (b.__rgseHardened || typeof b.renderValue !== "function") return;
      var orig = b.renderValue;
      b.renderValue = function (el, x, init) {
        try { return orig.call(this, el, x, init); }
        catch (e) { if (window.console && console.warn) console.warn("[rgse] widget render skipped:", e); }
      };
      b.__rgseHardened = true;
    });
  }
  harden();
  // Wrap staticRender: harden first (so it can never abort), then defer widgets
  // that are not currently visible so they are not initialised while hidden.
  if (window.HTMLWidgets && typeof HTMLWidgets.staticRender === "function") {
    var orig = HTMLWidgets.staticRender;
    HTMLWidgets.staticRender = function () {
      harden();
      document.querySelectorAll(".html-widget").forEach(function (el) {
        if (isHidden(el) && !hasTable(el)) {
          el.className += " html-widget-static-bound";   // makes the original loop skip it
          el.setAttribute("data-rgse-deferred", "1");
        }
      });
      return orig.apply(this, arguments);
    };
  }
  // Render any deferred widget once its tab/pill becomes visible, then fix widths.
  function onShown() {
    var any = false;
    document.querySelectorAll(".html-widget[data-rgse-deferred]").forEach(function (el) {
      if (!isHidden(el)) {
        el.className = el.className.replace(/\\bhtml-widget-static-bound\\b/g, "").trim();
        el.removeAttribute("data-rgse-deferred");
        any = true;
      }
    });
    if (any && window.HTMLWidgets) { harden(); try { HTMLWidgets.staticRender(); } catch (e) {} }
    if (window.jQuery && jQuery.fn && jQuery.fn.dataTable) {
      try { jQuery.fn.dataTable.tables({ visible: true, api: true }).columns.adjust(); } catch (e) {}
    }
  }
  if (window.jQuery) jQuery(function ($) { $(document).on("shown.bs.tab shown.bs.collapse", onShown); });
})();
</script>\n')
```

```{r overview, results='asis'}
cat(sprintf("- **Project**: %s\n", project_name))
cat(sprintf("- **Organism**: %s\n", gsub("_", " ", organism)))

cat(sprintf("- **Report generated**: %s\n\n", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")))

if (file.exists(list_comp_file)) {
  cat("\n**Comparison labels:**\n\n")
  # Group the condition tokens by comparison number so we can report one line
  # per comparison together with the number of DEGs (FDR < 0.05) found.
  lc <- readLines(list_comp_file)
  lc <- lc[nzchar(trimws(lc))]
  comp_conditions <- list(); comp_order <- character(0)
  for (line in lc) {
    parts <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(line, ":")))
    if (length(parts) >= 2) {
      cn   <- gsub("\\D", "", parts[1])
      cond <- trimws(paste(parts[-1], collapse = ":"))
      comp_conditions[[cn]] <- c(comp_conditions[[cn]], cond)
      if (!(cn %in% comp_order)) comp_order <- c(comp_order, cn)
    } else {
      cat(sprintf("- %s\n", line))
    }
  }
  for (cn in comp_order) {
    dc       <- deg_counts(paste0("DGE_analysis_comp", cn))
    cond_str <- paste(sub("^__", "", comp_conditions[[cn]]), collapse = " vs ")
    parts_deg <- vapply(names(dc), function(thr) {
      d <- dc[[thr]]
      if (is.na(d$total)) return(NA_character_)
      ud <- if (!is.na(d$up) && !is.na(d$down))
              sprintf(" (%d up / %d down)", d$up, d$down) else ""
      sprintf("**%d** at FDR<%s%s", d$total, thr, ud)
    }, character(1))
    parts_deg <- parts_deg[!is.na(parts_deg)]
    deg_str <- if (length(parts_deg) == 0) "DEG count not found"
               else paste(parts_deg, collapse = "; ")
    cat(sprintf("- **Comparison %s**: %s — DEGs: %s\n", cn, cond_str, deg_str))
  }
  cat("\n")
}

cat("\n**Analyses detected:**\n\n")
```

```{r main-loop, results='asis'}
for (idx in seq_along(comp_names)) {
  comp   <- comp_names[idx]
  label  <- if (!is.null(comp_labels[[comp]])) comp_labels[[comp]] else comp
  cp_dir <- cp_dirs[idx]  # may be NA if only panther exists

  comp_num <- gsub("\\D", "", comp)
  cat(sprintf("\n\n# Comparison %s {.tabset .tabset-pills}\n\n", comp_num))

  # Optional AI narrative for this comparison (above the tabs; absent unless enabled),
  # followed by the collapsible per-table notes (the MAP-step summaries).
  render_ai_insight(file.path(dge_dir, paste0(comp, ".enrichment_ai_insight.md")))
  render_pertable_ai(file.path(dge_dir, paste0(comp, ".enrichment_ai_pertable.tsv")))

  # ── clusterProfiler ORA ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (!is.na(cp_dir) && dir.exists(cp_dir)) {

    full_mode_ran <- length(list.files(cp_dir,
        pattern = "GSEA_|^MKEGG_|^WP_|^DO_|^NCG_|^DGN_")) > 0

    # DEG-input threshold as the top-level tab: FDR < 0.05 and FDR < 0.01 each get
    # their own ORA + GSEA sub-tabs, so the two thresholds are never mixed.
    cp_toks <- vapply(list.files(cp_dir, pattern = "\\.txt$"), threshold_token,
                      character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
    cp_toks <- unique(cp_toks[!is.na(cp_toks)])
    cp_toks <- intersect(c("fdr_05", "fdr_05_logpos", "fdr_05_logneg",
                           "fdr_01", "fdr_01_logpos", "fdr_01_logneg"), cp_toks)
    if (length(cp_toks) == 0) cp_toks <- c("fdr_05", "fdr_01")
    for (tok in cp_toks) {
      cat(sprintf("\n## %s {.tabset}\n\n", threshold_label(tok)))
      render_cp_threshold(cp_dir, comp, tok, full_mode_ran, primary = identical(tok, "fdr_05"))
    }

    # aPEAR pathway clusters (shared across thresholds; kept at comparison level)
    apear_files <- list.files(cp_dir, pattern = "_aPEAR_clusters\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)
    if (length(apear_files) > 0) {
      cat("\n## aPEAR Pathway Clusters\n\n")
      cat("Pathway clusters identified by the aPEAR algorithm, grouping similar enriched terms:\n\n")
      for (f in head(apear_files, 6)) {
        bname <- basename(f)
        df <- safe_read(f)
        if (!is.null(df) && nrow(df) > 0) {
          cat(sprintf("\n**%s** — %d clusters\n\n", bname, length(unique(df$Cluster))))
          make_table(df, gsub("\\.txt$", ".csv", bname), max_rows = 30)
        }
      }
      apear_pdfs <- list.files(cp_dir, pattern = "_aPEAR\\.pdf$", full.names = TRUE)
      for (p in head(apear_pdfs, 3)) embed_pdf(p, basename(p))
    }

  } else if (has_enrichr) {
    # Enrichr results from non-model organism path (flat folder)
    cat("\n## Enrichr (custom GO annotation) {.tabset}\n\n")

    # Discover DEG sets for this comparison (e.g. fdr_05, fdr_05_logneg, fdr_05_logpos, pval_05, ...)
    all_enrichr_txt <- list.files(enrichr_dir, pattern = "\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)
    all_enrichr_txt <- all_enrichr_txt[!grepl("_aPEAR|_similarity", all_enrichr_txt)]
    # Extract DEG set labels from file names: everything between comp_ and _Gene_IDs_functional_
    deg_sets <- unique(gsub("^.*?_(fdr_|pval_)", "\\1",
                   gsub("_Gene_IDs_functional_clusterProfiler_enrichr_.*", "", basename(all_enrichr_txt))))
    deg_sets <- deg_sets[grepl("^(fdr|pval)_", deg_sets)]
    deg_sets <- sort(unique(deg_sets))

    # Create readable labels
    deg_label <- function(s) {
      parts <- c()
      if (grepl("fdr", s))  parts <- c(parts, "FDR < 0.05")
      if (grepl("pval", s)) parts <- c(parts, "p-value < 0.05")
      if (grepl("logpos", s)) parts <- c(parts, "Up-regulated")
      else if (grepl("logneg", s)) parts <- c(parts, "Down-regulated")
      else parts <- c(parts, "All DEGs")
      paste(parts, collapse = " — ")
    }

    for (deg_set in deg_sets) {
      cat(sprintf("\n### %s {.tabset}\n\n", deg_label(deg_set)))

      for (ont in c("BP", "MF", "CC")) {
        ont_label <- c(BP = "Biological Process", MF = "Molecular Function",
                       CC = "Cellular Component")[[ont]]
        cat(sprintf("\n#### GO %s {.tabset}\n\n", ont_label))

        # Match files for this DEG set + ontology, only primary results (_1.txt)
        set_pattern <- sprintf("^%s_%s_Gene_IDs_functional_clusterProfiler_enrichr_%s_",
                               comp, deg_set, ont)
        ont_files <- list.files(enrichr_dir, pattern = set_pattern, full.names = TRUE)
        ont_files <- ont_files[grepl("\\.txt$", ont_files)]
        ont_files <- ont_files[!grepl("_aPEAR|_similarity", ont_files)]
        # Keep only primary (_1) results, skip secondary (_2)
        ont_files <- ont_files[grepl("_1\\.txt$|_expr_1\\.txt$", ont_files)]

        if (length(ont_files) > 0) {
          for (f in ont_files) {
            df  <- safe_read(f)
            sig <- filter_sig(df)
            n_sig <- if (!is.null(sig)) nrow(sig) else 0
            bg_label <- if (grepl("_expr_1\\.txt$", f)) "Expressed genes background" else "Whole annotation background"
            cat(sprintf("\n##### %s\n\n", bg_label))
            cat(sprintf("**%d** significant GO %s terms (adjusted p < 0.05)\n\n", n_sig, ont))
              make_table(df, sprintf("%s_%s_enrichr_GO_%s_%s.csv", comp, deg_set, ont, bg_label))
          }

          # aPEAR plots for this DEG set + ontology
          apear_pattern <- sprintf("^%s_%s_.*enrichr_%s_.*_aPEAR\\.pdf$", comp, deg_set, ont)
          apear_pdfs <- list.files(enrichr_dir, pattern = apear_pattern, full.names = TRUE)
          for (p in head(apear_pdfs, 2)) embed_pdf(p, basename(p))

          # aPEAR cluster tables
          apear_cl_pattern <- sprintf("^%s_%s_.*enrichr_%s_.*_aPEAR_clusters\\.txt$", comp, deg_set, ont)
          apear_clusters <- list.files(enrichr_dir, pattern = apear_cl_pattern, full.names = TRUE)
          for (f in head(apear_clusters, 2)) {
            df <- safe_read(f)
            if (!is.null(df) && nrow(df) > 0) {
              cat(sprintf("\n**aPEAR clusters** — %d clusters\n\n", length(unique(df$Cluster))))
              make_table(df, gsub("\\.txt$", ".csv", basename(f)), max_rows = 20)
            }
          }
        } else {
          cat("*Not available*\n\n")
        }
      }

      # --- KEGG Orthology tab ---
      cat("\n#### KEGG Orthology {.tabset}\n\n")
      kegg_pattern <- sprintf("^%s_%s_Gene_IDs_functional_clusterProfiler_enrichr_KEGG_",
                               comp, deg_set)
      kegg_files <- list.files(enrichr_dir, pattern = kegg_pattern, full.names = TRUE)
      kegg_files <- kegg_files[grepl("\\.txt$", kegg_files)]
      kegg_files <- kegg_files[!grepl("_aPEAR|_similarity", kegg_files)]
      kegg_files <- kegg_files[grepl("_1\\.txt$|_expr_1\\.txt$", kegg_files)]

      if (length(kegg_files) > 0) {
        for (f in kegg_files) {
          df  <- safe_read(f)
          sig <- filter_sig(df)
          n_sig <- if (!is.null(sig)) nrow(sig) else 0
          bg_label <- if (grepl("_expr_1\\.txt$", f)) "Expressed genes background" else "Whole annotation background"
          cat(sprintf("\n##### %s\n\n", bg_label))
          cat(sprintf("**%d** significant KEGG terms (adjusted p < 0.05)\n\n", n_sig))
            make_table(df, sprintf("%s_%s_enrichr_KEGG_%s.csv", comp, deg_set, bg_label))
        }
        kegg_apear <- list.files(enrichr_dir,
                     pattern = sprintf("^%s_%s_.*enrichr_KEGG_.*_aPEAR\\.pdf$", comp, deg_set),
                     full.names = TRUE)
        for (p in head(kegg_apear, 2)) embed_pdf(p, basename(p))
      } else {
        cat("*Not available*\n\n")
      }
    }
  } else {
    cat("\n*clusterProfiler results not found for this comparison*\n\n")
  }

  # ── autoGO / Enrichr ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  pant_dirs <- panther_dirs_all[grepl(paste0("^", comp, "_"), basename(panther_dirs_all))]
  if (length(pant_dirs) > 0) {
    cat("\n## autoGO & Panther {.tabset}\n\n")

    for (pd in pant_dirs) {
      pd_label <- basename(pd)
      # Determine if this is all DEGs, up, or down
      if (grepl("logpos", pd_label)) pd_label_nice <- "Up-regulated DEGs"
      else if (grepl("logneg", pd_label)) pd_label_nice <- "Down-regulated DEGs"
      else pd_label_nice <- "All DEGs (FDR < 0.05)"

      cat(sprintf("\n### %s {.tabset}\n\n", pd_label_nice))

      # autoGO results
      autogo_dirs <- list.dirs(pd, recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
      autogo_dirs <- autogo_dirs[grepl("_autoGO$", autogo_dirs)]
      if (length(autogo_dirs) > 0) {
        cat("\n#### autoGO / Enrichr\n\n")
        for (agd in autogo_dirs) {
          # Tables first — one per Enrichr database that returned results (ALL of
          # them). Databases that were queried but had no enriched terms simply
          # have no file here (e.g. Cellular Component when nothing was enriched).
          tsvs <- list.files(agd, pattern = "\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)
          for (f in tsvs) {
            df <- safe_read(f); sig <- filter_sig(df)
            n_sig <- if (!is.null(sig)) nrow(sig) else 0
            n_tot <- if (!is.null(df)) nrow(df) else 0
            # Significance is by ADJUSTED p-value (< 0.05); the table itself is
            # sorted by raw p-value, so rows with raw p < 0.05 may still show as
            # "0 ... at adjusted p < 0.05".
            cat(sprintf("\n**%s** — %d of %d terms at adjusted p < 0.05\n\n",
                        basename(f), n_sig, n_tot))
            make_table(df, gsub("\\.tsv$", ".csv", basename(f)), max_rows = 15)
          }
          # Then the plots — ALL databases, not just the first few: bar plots
          # first, then the matching lolliplots.
          bplots <- list.files(agd, pattern = "_barplot\\.png$", full.names = TRUE)
          for (p in bplots) embed_png(p, basename(p), max_width = "600px")
          lplots <- list.files(agd, pattern = "_lolliplot\\.png$", full.names = TRUE)
          for (p in lplots) embed_png(p, basename(p), max_width = "600px")
        }
      }

      # Panther results
      panther_files <- list.files(pd, pattern = "^enriched_.*_panther\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)
      panther_files <- panther_files[!grepl("_err\\.txt$", panther_files)]
      if (length(panther_files) > 0) {
        cat("\n#### Panther enrichment {.tabset}\n\n")

        # Group by test type (fisher/binom) and background (whole/expr)
        for (test_type in c("fisher_whole_back", "fisher_expr_back",
                            "binom_whole_back", "binom_expr_back")) {
          pf <- panther_files[grepl(test_type, panther_files)]
          if (length(pf) == 0) next

          test_label <- gsub("_", " ", tools::toTitleCase(gsub("_", " ", test_type)))
          cat(sprintf("\n##### %s\n\n", test_label))

          for (f in head(pf, 5)) {
            df <- safe_read(f)
            if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) next
            sig <- filter_sig(df)
            n_sig <- if (!is.null(sig)) nrow(sig) else 0
            cat(sprintf("**%s** — %d significant results\n\n", basename(f), n_sig))
            make_table(df, gsub("\\.txt$", ".csv", basename(f)), max_rows = 15)
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  # ── REVIGO results ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (!is.na(cp_dir) && dir.exists(cp_dir)) {
    revigo_pdfs <- list.files(cp_dir, pattern = "revigo\\.pdf$", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
    if (length(revigo_pdfs) > 0) {
      cat("\n## REVIGO Semantic Similarity\n\n")
      cat("REVIGO reduces redundancy among significant GO terms by clustering semantically similar terms:\n\n")
      for (p in head(revigo_pdfs, 4)) embed_pdf(p, basename(p), dpi = 72)
      if (length(revigo_pdfs) > 4)
        cat(sprintf("*...and %d more REVIGO visualisations in the archive*\n\n", length(revigo_pdfs) - 4))
    }
  }

  cat("\n\n---\n\n")
}
```


```{r network, results='asis'}
if (has_network) {
  cat("\n\n# Network Analyses {.tabset}\n\n")

  wgcna_dir  <- file.path(network_dir, "WGCNA")
  string_dir <- file.path(network_dir, "STRINGdb")
  bonobo_dir <- file.path(network_dir, "BONOBO")

  has_wgcna  <- dir.exists(wgcna_dir) && length(list.files(wgcna_dir)) > 0
  has_string <- dir.exists(string_dir) && length(list.files(string_dir)) > 0
  has_bonobo <- dir.exists(bonobo_dir) && length(list.files(bonobo_dir, recursive = TRUE)) > 0

  # ── WGCNA ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (has_wgcna) {
    cat("\n## WGCNA {.tabset}\n\n")
    cat("Weighted Gene Co-expression Network Analysis — module detection via `blockwiseModules()`:\n\n")

    # Module-condition heatmap (PNG)
    heatmaps <- list.files(wgcna_dir, pattern = "WGCNA_module_type_.*\\.png$", full.names = TRUE)
    for (p in heatmaps) embed_png(p, gsub("WGCNA_module_type_|\\.png$", "", basename(p)))

    # Hub genes
    hub_files <- list.files(wgcna_dir, pattern = "WGCNA_top10_hub_genes_", full.names = TRUE)
    if (length(hub_files) > 0) {
      cat("\n### Hub Genes\n\n")
      cat("Top 10 hub genes per module ranked by intramodular connectivity (kWithin):\n\n")
      for (f in hub_files) {
        df <- safe_read(f)
        if (!is.null(df) && nrow(df) > 0) {
          cat(sprintf("\n**%s**\n\n", gsub("WGCNA_top10_hub_genes_|\\.txt$", "", basename(f))))
          make_table(df, gsub("\\.txt$", ".csv", basename(f)), max_rows = 30)
        }
      }
    }

    # Module assignments
    mod_files <- list.files(wgcna_dir, pattern = "WGCNA_all_modules_", full.names = TRUE)
    if (length(mod_files) > 0) {
      cat("\n### Module Assignments\n\n")
      for (f in mod_files) {
        df <- safe_read(f)
        if (!is.null(df) && nrow(df) > 0) {
          n_mods <- length(unique(df$clusters))
          cat(sprintf("**%s** — %d modules, %d genes\n\n", basename(f), n_mods, nrow(df)))
          make_table(df, gsub("\\.txt$", ".csv", basename(f)), max_rows = 20)
        }
      }
    }

    # Module-trait correlation
    cor_files <- list.files(wgcna_dir, pattern = "WGCNA_module_trait_cor_", full.names = TRUE)
    if (length(cor_files) > 0) {
      cat("\n### Module-Trait Correlation\n\n")
      for (f in cor_files) {
        df <- safe_read(f)
        if (!is.null(df) && nrow(df) > 0) {
          cat(sprintf("**%s**\n\n", basename(f)))
          make_table(df, gsub("\\.txt$", ".csv", basename(f)), max_rows = 30)
        }
      }
    }

    # Dendrograms / other PDFs
    wgcna_pdfs <- list.files(wgcna_dir, pattern = "\\.pdf$", full.names = TRUE)
    wgcna_pdfs <- head(wgcna_pdfs[!grepl("blockwiseModules", wgcna_pdfs)], 5)
    if (length(wgcna_pdfs) > 0) {
      cat("\n### WGCNA Plots\n\n")
      for (p in wgcna_pdfs) embed_pdf(p, basename(p))
    }
  }

  # ── STRINGdb ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (has_string) {
    cat("\n## STRINGdb {.tabset}\n\n")
    cat("Protein-protein interaction network analysis via STRINGdb (score threshold ≥ 400):\n\n")

    # PPI enrichment test
    ppi_files <- list.files(string_dir, pattern = "STRINGdb_PPI_enrichment_test_", full.names = TRUE)
    for (f in ppi_files) {
      df <- safe_read(f)
      if (!is.null(df) && nrow(df) > 0) {
        cat(sprintf("**PPI enrichment test** (%s):\n\n", gsub("STRINGdb_PPI_enrichment_test_|\\.txt$", "", basename(f))))
        make_table(df, gsub("\\.txt$", ".csv", basename(f)))
      }
    }

    # Functional enrichment from STRING
    enrich_files <- list.files(string_dir, pattern = "STRINGdb_functional_enrichment_", full.names = TRUE)
    if (length(enrich_files) > 0) {
      cat("\n### Functional Enrichment\n\n")
      for (f in enrich_files) {
        df <- safe_read(f); sig <- filter_sig(df)
        n_sig <- if (!is.null(sig)) nrow(sig) else 0
        cat(sprintf("**%s** — %d significant terms\n\n", basename(f), n_sig))
        make_table(df, gsub("\\.txt$", ".csv", basename(f)))
      }
    }

    # Cluster assignments
    cluster_files <- list.files(string_dir, pattern = "STRINGdb_all_modules_", full.names = TRUE)
    if (length(cluster_files) > 0) {
      cat("\n### Network Clusters\n\n")
      for (f in cluster_files) {
        df <- safe_read(f)
        if (!is.null(df) && nrow(df) > 0) {
          cat(sprintf("**%s** — %d clusters\n\n", basename(f), length(unique(df$clusters))))
          make_table(df, gsub("\\.txt$", ".csv", basename(f)), max_rows = 20)
        }
      }
    }

    # Network plots
    string_pdfs <- list.files(string_dir, pattern = "\\.pdf$", full.names = TRUE)
    if (length(string_pdfs) > 0) {
      cat("\n### Network Plots\n\n")
      for (p in head(string_pdfs, 5)) embed_pdf(p, basename(p))
      if (length(string_pdfs) > 5)
        cat(sprintf("*...and %d more network plots in the archive*\n\n", length(string_pdfs) - 5))
    }
  }

  # ── BONOBO ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (has_bonobo) {
    cat("\n## BONOBO\n\n")
    cat("Bayesian Optimized Networks (BONOBO) via netZooPy — regulatory network inference:\n\n")
    bonobo_files <- list.files(bonobo_dir, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
    if (length(bonobo_files) > 0) {
      for (f in head(bonobo_files, 5)) {
        df <- safe_read(f)
        if (!is.null(df) && nrow(df) > 0) {
          cat(sprintf("**%s** — %d rows\n\n", basename(f), nrow(df)))
          make_table(df, basename(f), max_rows = 15)
        }
      }
    } else {
      cat("*BONOBO output files not found.*\n\n")
    }
  }

  if (!has_wgcna && !has_string && !has_bonobo) {
    cat("*Network analyses were requested but no output files were found.*\n\n")
  }
}
```
